session_canary.scope: one continuous VU reuses its session and renews near actual access-token expiry

resources.ownership_scope: Observed OS owner censuses are listed for each pressure/rest plateau and final idle; their equality is reported explicitly rather than assumed. RSS/anonymous retention alone does not establish allocation ownership or absolute absence of a leak. PostgreSQL memory includes reclaimable cache; kernel memory.peak may transiently exceed memory.max by a charge batch.

fixture_census.scope: Read-only post-load census for an owned single-project fixture. Counts are taken after measured traffic, with a fresh read-only connection; preparation/load durations and performance samples are unchanged. This does not certify every integrity or ownership gate.
